title: Meet SyteRoam: CloudSuite Industrial, Now Truly Mobile
excerpt: Today, we're proud to launch SyteRoam - the native mobile app for CloudSuite Industrial (SyteLine), built specifically for manufacturing and service businesses.
alt: Worker using mobile ERP app on smartphone in manufacturing plant
content:
ERP has always been powerful. But mobile ERP? Usually frustrating.

Small buttons. Broken workflows. Desktop screens awkwardly forced onto a phone.

That’s exactly why we built SyteRoam.

Today, we’re proud to launch SyteRoam - the native mobile app for CloudSuite Industrial (SyteLine), built specifically for manufacturing and service businesses that need ERP access beyond the office.

  • Not a browser shortcut.
  • Not a scaled-down web portal.
  • A proper mobile experience.

Built for the way modern teams actually work.

Why SyteRoam?

  • Manufacturing teams are rarely behind desks.
  • Sales teams are meeting customers.
  • Buyers are working with suppliers.
  • Production teams are on the shop floor.
  • Quality teams are carrying out inspections.
  • Maintenance teams are solving problems in real time.

Yet ERP systems have traditionally tied them to laptops.

SyteRoam changes that. It brings the full power of CloudSuite Industrial into a touch-first mobile experience, giving teams access to live ERP data wherever work happens.

Built for Speed. Designed for Action.

SyteRoam has been built from the ground up for mobile.

Every screen, action, and workflow is designed for touch - making it faster to navigate, easier to use, and more practical in fast-moving environments.

Whether you’re:

  • Managing customer opportunities
  • Raising purchase orders
  • Tracking supplier deliveries
  • Reviewing production activity
  • Logging quality checks

SyteRoam keeps everything connected in real time.

One App. Every Team.

SyteRoam supports the operational backbone of your business:

  • Sales & CRM: Track leads, manage opportunities, and access customer history.
  • Procurement: Create, review, and approve purchasing activity from anywhere.
  • Production: Stay connected to live manufacturing workflows.
  • Quality: Capture inspections and maintain compliance instantly.
  • Maintenance: Handle service tasks directly from the shop floor.

And this is only the beginning. SyteRoam is built to scale across departments as your business grows.

Designed Around Your Device

Your ERP should adapt to how you work.

SyteRoam intelligently adjusts its layout across phones and tablets, creating the best possible workflow whether you’re in portrait or landscape.

  • Focused when you need simplicity.
  • Expanded when you need visibility.
  • Productive wherever you are.

ERP Without Boundaries

Need to approve a purchase order while visiting a supplier? Update a sales opportunity between meetings? Check production progress on the shop floor? Resolve a quality issue immediately?

That’s what SyteRoam is built for.

No laptop. No waiting. No compromise.
Just ERP - wherever work happens.

Contact Us for more details.

title: Why Your Mobile App for Cloud Suite Industrial Is Slowing Down Decision-Making and How to Fix It
excerpt: Running a business efficiently requires access to accurate information wherever work happens. Learn why some mobile apps for Cloud Suite Industrial slow down decision-making and how to fix it.
alt: Shop floor worker frustrated with a slow mobile ERP app showing loading indicator on the factory floor
content:
Running a business efficiently requires access to accurate information wherever work happens. Many organizations rely on a mobile app for Cloud Suite Industrial to keep teams connected to their ERP system while away from their desks. However, not every mobile solution delivers the speed, usability, and real-time visibility users expect.

Slow screens, complicated workflows, and delayed access to critical information can reduce productivity and make decision-making harder than it should be. This article explores the common causes of poor mobile ERP experiences and what businesses should look for in a better solution.

The Hidden Cost of a Slow Mobile Experience

Many organizations do not realize how much time is lost when employees struggle to access ERP information on mobile devices. Sales teams wait for customer details, managers delay approvals, and service teams lack visibility into current ERP data while working remotely.

Even small delays can have a significant impact. When users need to switch between systems, return to their desks, or wait for information to load, productivity suffers. Over time, these interruptions create inefficiencies that affect customer service, reporting accuracy, and operational responsiveness.

The challenge is not always the ERP itself. In many cases, the mobile application layer creates unnecessary friction between users and the information they need.

What a Purpose-Built Cloud Suite Industrial Mobile App Should Do

There is a clear difference between a general-purpose mobile app and one built specifically around your ERP workflows. A purpose-built app does not just display data. It captures transactions at the exact moment they happen.

With a well-designed app, they scan the item, confirm the quantity, and the ERP updates immediately. No paper. No double entry. No waiting until the end of the shift to update the system. That single improvement, repeated across every transaction in the day, adds up fast.

  • Real-time inventory updates as items are picked, moved, or received
  • Work order tracking with live status changes visible to supervisors
  • Labour time capture at the job level without leaving the work area
  • Barcode and QR scanning that talks directly to the ERP with no delay
  • Role-based screens so each worker only sees what they need

These capabilities help users stay productive without requiring constant access to a desktop computer.

Common Signs Your Current Mobile App Is Holding Users Back

Mobile ERP challenges are often mistaken for training issues or process problems. In reality, the application itself may create unnecessary obstacles.

Common warning signs include:

  • Users avoiding the mobile app and returning to desktop access whenever possible
  • Slow screen loading times and poor responsiveness
  • Multiple steps required to complete simple actions
  • Limited access to the information users needs most frequently
  • Inconsistent user experiences across devices
  • Difficulty accessing dashboards, reports, or approval workflows while travelling

When these issues become common, the mobile solution may prevent users from getting the full value of CloudSuite Industrial.

How to Fix It: Choosing the Right SyteLine Mobile App Solutions

When evaluating mobile ERP solutions, organisations should focus on usability, performance, and integration of quality.

Important considerations include:

  • Real-time ERP integration that provides immediate access to current information
  • Role-based user experiences that simplify navigation and improve productivity
  • Fast performance across smartphones and tablets
  • Secure access to ERP data from any location
  • Support for approvals, dashboards, reporting, and business workflows
  • Easy deployment and adoption across the organisation

Since SyteRoam operates in real time, users always work with current ERP information whenever they are connected.

Real Impact: What Changes When the App Works Right

When users have fast and reliable access to CloudSuite Industrial data, decisions happen faster and with greater confidence.

Managers gain immediate visibility into business performance. Sales teams can access customer information without returning to the office. Approval processes move faster, and users spend less time searching for information.

The result is improved responsiveness, greater productivity, and stronger adoption of ERP processes across the organisation.

Rather than acting as a barrier, the mobile application becomes a practical extension of the ERP system.

Improve Mobile Access to CloudSuite Industrial

If your users struggle to access CloudSuite Industrial efficiently on mobile devices, the issue may not be your ERP system. The right mobile solution can improve visibility, simplify workflows, and help teams stay productive wherever they work.

SyteRoam provides real-time mobile access to CloudSuite Industrial, giving users secure access to ERP information, approvals, dashboards, and business processes from their mobile devices. If you are looking to improve the mobile ERP experience across your organisation, we can help.

Frequently Asked Questions

Why is my mobile app slow when connected to CloudSuite Industrial?

Mobile app performance issues are often caused by inefficient integration with the ERP system, excessive data processing, or poorly designed user interfaces. If users experience slow loading times, delayed updates, or complex navigation, productivity can suffer. A well-designed mobile solution should provide fast, responsive access to CloudSuite Industrial data and processes.

Can a mobile app really affect business productivity?

Yes. Mobile applications play a critical role in how quickly employees can access information, complete approvals, review reports, and make decisions. Even small delays or complicated workflows can add up over time, reducing efficiency and increasing frustration across teams. A streamlined mobile experience helps users stay productive wherever they work.

What is the difference between a generic mobile app and one designed for CloudSuite Industrial?

A generic mobile app typically provides broad functionality across multiple systems and industries. A solution designed specifically for CloudSuite Industrial focuses on ERP workflows, business processes, and real-time data access. This often results in a more intuitive user experience, better performance, and stronger integration with the ERP environment.

Does a better mobile app require replacing the entire ERP system?

No. The ERP system remains unchanged. A mobile solution simply provides a more effective way for users to access ERP information and processes from their mobile devices. This allows organisations to improve usability and accessibility without disrupting their existing CloudSuite Industrial investment.

What should I look for in a mobile app for CloudSuite Industrial?

Look for real-time ERP integration, intuitive role-based screens, strong security, responsive performance, and support for key business functions such as approvals, reporting, dashboards, and data access. The best solutions make CloudSuite Industrial easier to use while helping employees stay productive away from their desks.

How quickly can a new mobile app deliver results?

Many organisations notice improvements shortly after implementation. Faster access to information, simplified workflows, and improved user adoption often become apparent within the first few weeks. Over time, these benefits can lead to better decision-making, increased productivity, and greater value from the ERP system.

title: Item Availability Drill-Down
metaTitle: Item Availability Drill-Down: Real-Time Inventory Visibility | SyteRoam
metaDescription: Instantly view on-hand, allocated, and available inventory across sites and warehouses with SyteRoam's new Item Availability Drill-Down feature.
excerpt: Instantly view on-hand, allocated, and available inventory across sites and warehouses with SyteRoam's new Item Availability Drill-Down feature.
content:
Item Availability Drill-Down: Find the Right Inventory, Faster

Inventory visibility is one of the biggest challenges for organizations operating across multiple sites and warehouses. It's not enough to know how much inventory exists—teams also need to know exactly where it is, how much is available for use, and whether it's already allocated or expected through incoming receipts.

That's why SyteRoam has introduced the Item Availability Drill-Down feature, making inventory exploration faster, simpler, and more intuitive.

Instead of navigating through multiple screens or reports, users can now drill down from the highest level of the inventory hierarchy to the exact warehouse location where stock resides—all within a single, streamlined interface.

One View. Complete Inventory Visibility.

The new Item Availability screen provides an immediate summary of inventory for any selected item.

At the top level, users can instantly view:

  • Available Quantity
  • On-Hand Inventory
  • Allocated Stock
  • Expected Receipts

This gives planners, warehouse teams, customer service representatives, and sales personnel an immediate answer to the most common question:

"Do we have this item available?"

But the real power begins when users drill deeper.

Navigate Through Your Entire Inventory Hierarchy

With expandable inventory cards, users can progressively drill into each level of their inventory structure.

The hierarchy includes:

  • Enterprise
  • Site
  • Warehouse
  • Stock Location

For example, selecting a site displays every warehouse within that location. Expanding a warehouse immediately reveals individual inventory locations such as:

  • Stock
  • Pack
  • Ship
  • Floor
  • Transit

Each level displays the available quantity without requiring additional searches or navigation.

This hierarchical approach allows users to understand inventory distribution in seconds.

Make Better Decisions with Real-Time Inventory Data

Every inventory level provides key metrics that matter:

  • On Hand – Physical inventory currently in stock
  • Allocated – Quantity already reserved for existing orders
  • Receipts – Incoming inventory expected through purchase orders or transfers
  • Available – Inventory immediately available for new demand

Having these values visible together helps eliminate guesswork.

Instead of simply seeing that an item exists somewhere in the organization, users know exactly what can actually be promised to customers.

Built for Faster Operations

Whether you're handling customer inquiries, planning production, managing warehouse operations, or coordinating inventory transfers, the Item Availability Drill-Down significantly reduces the time spent searching for stock.

Typical use cases include:

  • Quickly locating available inventory across multiple sites
  • Identifying which warehouse has immediate stock
  • Understanding why available inventory differs from on-hand quantities
  • Viewing incoming receipts before committing to new orders
  • Supporting customer service with accurate inventory information during live calls

Everything is presented in a clean, mobile-friendly interface designed for fast navigation.

Inventory Intelligence in One Streamlined Screen

Modern inventory management requires more than static stock reports. Teams need real-time visibility that follows the way inventory is actually organized across the business.

The new Item Availability Drill-Down feature in SyteRoam delivers exactly that—allowing users to move seamlessly from enterprise-level inventory summaries down to individual warehouse locations while maintaining complete visibility of availability, allocations, and receipts.

No switching between screens. No complex reports. Just the information you need, exactly where you need it.

Drill into your inventory hierarchy from enterprise to location—all from one streamlined form.

content:
Create, Attach, and Access Notes & Documents from Anywhere in CloudSuite Industrial (SyteLine)

Manufacturing and distribution teams rely on accurate information to keep operations moving. Whether it's special shipping instructions, customer-specific requirements, inspection photos, or supporting documents, having the right information available at the right time can make all the difference.

For organizations using CloudSuite Industrial (SyteLine), mobile access to this information has traditionally been limited. That's where SyteRoam bridges the gap.

The latest SyteRoam release introduces Notes & Documents on Records, allowing users to create, attach, search, and access notes and documents directly from their mobile device. Integrated with CloudSuite Industrial ERP, this feature ensures critical business information is always available—whether you're on the warehouse floor, visiting a customer, or working remotely.

Extend CloudSuite Industrial ERP Beyond the Desktop

While CloudSuite Industrial (SyteLine) stores valuable operational data, many day-to-day activities happen away from a desk.

Warehouse personnel need shipping instructions.
Sales representatives need customer notes before meetings.
Field technicians need to upload photos and service reports immediately after completing work.

With SyteRoam, users can access and update these records directly from their smartphone or tablet, extending the capabilities of CloudSuite Industrial ERP into the field.

Create Notes Wherever Work Happens

Important conversations and updates shouldn't wait until the end of the day.

Users can now create notes directly from their mobile device while working inside SyteLine records.

Each note includes:

  • Subject
  • Detailed description
  • Date and time stamp
  • Internal visibility option
  • Fast search capability

Whether recording special shipping instructions, customer requests, installation details, or service observations, every note is immediately available to authorized users connected to CloudSuite Industrial (SyteLine).

This eliminates paper notes, forgotten emails, and manual follow-ups.

Attach Documents Directly to Business Records

Supporting documents are often just as important as ERP transactions.

With SyteRoam, users can upload and access documents without returning to the office.

Supported attachments include:

  • PDF files
  • DOCX Documents
  • JPG or PNG images
  • Text documents

Every attachment remains linked to the appropriate customer or business record, creating a centralized source of information that complements your CloudSuite Industrial ERP data.

Whether you're capturing photos from a customer site or attaching shipping documentation, everything stays organized and accessible.

Quickly Search Notes and Documents

As customer histories grow, locating the right information becomes increasingly important.

The new Notes and Documents interface includes built-in search functionality, making it easy to find:

  • Shipping instructions
  • Credit-related notes
  • Customer communications
  • Technical documentation
  • Previously uploaded files

Instead of searching through emails or shared folders, users can retrieve information directly from the record within seconds.

Improve Collaboration Across Every Department

Because notes and documents are stored with the business record, every department works with the same information.

Customer service teams can answer inquiries faster.
Warehouse staff can review handling instructions before shipping.
Sales teams can prepare for customer meetings with complete visibility.
Field technicians can upload service notes immediately after completing work.

By extending CloudSuite Industrial (SyteLine) to mobile devices, SyteRoam helps eliminate communication gaps while improving collaboration across the organization.

Mobile Productivity for CloudSuite Industrial (SyteLine) Users

Modern ERP users expect information to be available wherever work takes them.

With SyteRoam's new Notes & Documents on Records feature, organizations using CloudSuite Industrial ERP can give employees secure mobile access to the information they need—without waiting to return to a desk.

Combined with the new Item Availability Drill-Down feature, SyteRoam continues to expand the mobile capabilities of CloudSuite Industrial (SyteLine), helping manufacturers, distributors, and field teams work more efficiently from anywhere.

Create, attach, and view notes and documents from anywhere—no desk required.

title: SyteRoam: The SyteLine ERP Mobile App for Real-Time Access, No Desk Required
metaTitle: SyteLine ERP Mobile App, Real-Time Access | SyteRoam
metaDescription: SyteRoam is the SyteLine ERP mobile app that puts live sales, inventory, and purchasing data in your pocket, within your existing permissions. Book a demo.
excerpt: Ask most manufacturing teams where their ERP lives, and the honest answer is: at a desk. The data that runs the business, orders, stock, customers, purchasing, sits inside SyteLine...
content:
Ask most manufacturing teams where their ERP lives, and the honest answer is: at a desk. The data that runs the business, orders, stock, customers, purchasing, sits inside SyteLine, and SyteLine sits on a workstation. That was never a problem when work happened at a workstation too. But most of the work that decides whether an order ships on time does not. It happens on the floor, at a supplier's site, and in the room with a customer.

That gap between where the data lives and where the decisions get made is the real cost most teams have stopped noticing. SyteRoam is built to close it.

The quiet cost of a desk-bound ERP

When people cannot reach live data in the moment, they do not stop working. They work around it. A sales rep quotes availability from memory. A buyer raises an order without checking what is already inbound. A planner assumes a component is on the shelf because it usually is. Each workaround feels harmless in isolation. Together, they are a steady drip of avoidable delays, duplicate orders, and follow-up calls that exist only because the answer was locked on a screen someone could not get to.

The instinct is to blame effort. It is almost never effort. It is access. The teams that move fastest are simply the ones who can see what is happening the moment it happens, rather than waiting to get back to a desk to find out.

Why "mobile ERP" usually disappoints people who know their system

Plenty of apps promise ERP on your phone. Most under-deliver in the same way: they hand you a watered-down version of your desktop. A cached snapshot that is already stale. A read-only summary that cannot answer a real question. Worst of all, a separate database that quietly drifts out of sync with the system of record, so you are never quite sure whether what you are looking at is true.

For anyone who actually knows SyteLine, that is worse than no app at all. A number you cannot trust is a liability, not a convenience. So the bar for a genuinely useful syteline erp mobile app is not "does it run on a phone." It is "is it the real system, live, with the same rules." That is the bar SyteRoam was built to clear.

What real-time access actually means

SyteRoam gives your team erp mobile access to live SyteLine data, from a phone or tablet, wherever they are working. Three things make that meaningful rather than marketing.

It is your real data, not a copy. SyteRoam connects to your CloudSuite Industrial (SyteLine) environment with no duplicate database and no parallel system to reconcile. What is in SyteLine is what you see, at the moment you look. Because SyteRoam is listed on the Infor Marketplace, it has been vetted to connect with the system you already run, so you are extending SyteLine, not bolting an unknown tool onto it.

It is live, not recent. There is a real difference between data pulled this morning and data pulled right now. In a business where stock moves and orders change through every shift, "recent" is a guess with a timestamp. Real-time is the actual state of things. That distinction is the whole reason to reach for the app instead of the last report.

It respects the controls you already built. SyteRoam works inside each user's existing SyteLine roles and permissions. What someone can see on the desktop is exactly what they see on mobile, nothing more. No new logins to provision, no separate access layer for IT to maintain. For an Operations Director or IT Admin, that means broad reach without a new security surface to worry about.

What SyteRoam gives your team today

  • Live Sales & CRM so reps can act on leads, opportunities, and customer orders in the field instead of after the fact.
  • Real-time inventory so anyone can confirm what stock exists and where, without a callback to the office.
  • Purchasing visibility so buyers can check order status and vendor detail the moment they need it.

This is the work that genuinely happens away from a desk, and it is deliberately a starting point rather than a finish line. More SyteLine roles are rolling out, and SyteRoam is designed to grow alongside them as your mobile companion to the system, not a replacement for it.

Where it shows up in a normal day

  • On the production floor, a planner confirms a component's stock and location without walking back to a terminal.
  • At a supplier's site, a buyer pulls up live order status and history and resolves a question in the conversation instead of a follow-up email.
  • In a customer meeting, a rep checks real availability across sites and closes the order on the spot, no "let me get back to you."
  • Between meetings, a manager reviews what is moving and catches a slipping order before it reaches the schedule.

Put SyteLine where the work happens

Your ERP already holds what your team needs to make good decisions. The only question is whether they can reach it in the moment those decisions get made. When live SyteLine data travels with your people, the workarounds fade, the follow-up calls shrink, and the business moves at the speed of the floor rather than the speed of the nearest desk.

If your team spends real time away from a workstation, see what real-time access changes. Book a demo and we will walk you through SyteRoam live against your own SyteLine data.

Frequently Asked Questions

Is SyteRoam a separate system from SyteLine?

No. SyteRoam connects live to your existing CloudSuite Industrial (SyteLine) environment, with no duplicate database. You are viewing and acting on the same data that lives in SyteLine, in real time, within your existing permissions.

What can my team do in SyteRoam today?

Live Sales & CRM, real-time inventory, and purchasing visibility, the workflows that happen away from a desk. Additional SyteLine roles are rolling out in future releases.

How is this different from other mobile ERP apps?

Many mobile apps show a cached or read-only copy of your data. SyteRoam surfaces your live SyteLine data directly, with the same permissions structure, so what you see on mobile is the real, current state of the system.

Do I need to set up new logins or permissions for mobile users?

No. SyteRoam inherits each user's existing SyteLine roles. Whatever a user can access on the desktop is what they access on mobile, with no reconfiguration required.
